summary: Elevate your leadership capabilities through our Management Training Course. Learn proven strategies to coach and motivate your team towards excellence.
lede: Leadership coaching training helps HR, talent and management-development professionals assess managers’ needs and plan targeted behavioral development. Participants practice structuring coaching conversations with GROW, CLEAR and OSCAR, interpreting 360-degree feedback and EQ-i 2.0 metrics, and building intervention plans and scorecards to track progress across hybrid teams and succession pipelines.
audienceIntro: This course is specifically designed for professionals responsible for developing management capability, driving behavioral change, and overseeing leadership pipelines within their organizations.
modules: Coaching in Hybrid and Digital Environments
Scaling Coaching Culture and Systemic Alignment
prerequisites: Participants should have a minimum of 3 years of experience in HR, talent management, organizational development, or senior operational leadership. A foundational understanding of basic performance management processes is expected. No prior formal coaching certification or advanced data analytics coding skills are required.
